# Refusal codes

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-refusal-codes.py; do not edit by hand -->

Every `EngineError` the auction engine can refuse with. The wire code is `6000 + engine code`; a failed transaction reads `Program error [6001]: Program error 1: NotAdmin`. The v0.2.4 programs and the 0.4 engine share this enum (through `crates/auction_engine_params`), so one catalogue covers both. `Proved by` lists the tests whose body names the variant or its wire form.

## Gaps

Variants with no proving test yet:

- `VaultBelowCollateral`: Raised only through the `AuctionError` -> `EngineError` conversion (`quote_liquidation`); no test yet drives an under-funded position vault to the engine's wire code. Closes with the Tier 2/3 liquidation refusal tests.
